title.value: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law
title.provenance: Provides that the amendatory Act may be referred to as the Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law.

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemical" means any of the perfluoroalkyl substances or polyfluoroalkyl substances included in the United States Environmental Protection Agency's expanded ToxCast chemical inventory.

type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in any of the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical

who.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use

action.provenance: sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use

products.provenance: (1) Carpets or rugs. (2) Fabric treatments. (3) Food packaging. (4) Juvenile products. (5) Oil and gas products. (6) Apparel.

intentionally_added.provenance: if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical

type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State that contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical ... shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the cookware's product label

action.provenance: shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the product label

products.provenance: "Cookware" means a durable houseware product that is used in residences or kitchens to prepare, dispense, or store food or beverages.

value: Surface area not large enough for a product label that meets the requirements of subsection (f)
Cookware has an exterior container or wrapper on which a product label can appear, or a tag/label to which information about the cookware may be attached
exceptions.provenance: Cookware is exempt from this Section if it meets all of the following requirements: (1) The surface area of the cookware is not large enough for a product label ... (2) The cookware does not have any of the following: (A) An exterior container or wrapper upon which a product label can appear or be affixed. (B) A tag or label to which information about the cookware may be attached.

intentionally_added.provenance: contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical

type.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer ... shall submit a written notification to the Agency that includes: (1) the trade name of the product; (2) a description of the purpose that PFAS chemicals serve in the product; (3) the name and physical address of the PFAS manufacturer; ...

date.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer who sells or distributes a product containing intentionally added PFAS chemicals for use in the State on or before December 31, 2024 shall submit the written notification required under this subsection no later than 30 days before January 1, 2025.

who.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer ... shall submit a written notification

action.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer who sells or distributes a product ... shall submit the written notification
